result.stdout:
Usage: cdp <namespace|command> [options]

Global options:
  -h, --help  Show help.
  --version   Show version.

Commands:
  batch       Print a journey as agent-browser batch JSON: cdp batch x.journey |
              agent-browser batch --bail
  check       Parse journeys without running them, and report every error with
              its line.
  chrome      Show which Chrome would be used, or every place that was searched.
  parse       Print a journey's parsed steps as JSON, for runners outside .NET
              (secrets stay references).
  run         Run journeys and print every checkpoint. A run reaches only the
              base URL's host and allowed hosts.
  screenshot  Open one page and save a PNG of it. Only the page's host is
              reachable unless allowed.
  snapshot    Open one page and print its accessibility tree. Only the page's
              host is reachable unless allowed.

result.stdout:
Usage: cdp run [<files...>] [options]

   Run journeys and print every checkpoint. A run reaches only the base URL's host and allowed hosts.

Arguments:
  [<files...>]  [variadic] Journey files.

Global options:
  -h, --help               Show help.

Options:
  -b, --base-url <string>  What relative 'open' URLs resolve against: a URL, or a folder for file:// pages. [default: null]
  -a, --allow <values>     [repeatable] Another host pattern the run may reach (repeatable): host, *.domain or *. [default: null]
  --file-root <string>     The folder file:// URLs may point into, when the base URL is not a folder. [default: null]
  --artifacts <string>     The folder journeys may write files into (screenshot, network har stop). Off unless given. [default: null]
  --headed                 Show the browser window.
  --json                   Print JSON; everything under a "page" key came from the page.
  --max-output <int>       Characters per checkpoint before it is cut (0 for no limit). [default: 20000]
  --timeout <value>        Seconds an action waits for its element (default 5). [default: default]

result.stdout:
Usage: cdp screenshot <url> --output <string> [options]

   Open one page and save a PNG of it. Only the page's host is reachable unless allowed.

Arguments:
  <url>  A URL, or a local HTML file.

Global options:
  -h, --help               Show help.

Options:
  -o, --output <string>    [required] The PNG file to write.
  -s, --selector <string>  Only the first element this CSS selector matches. [default: null]
  -f, --full               The whole page, past the viewport.
  --width <int>            Viewport width in CSS pixels. [default: 1280]
  --height <int>           Viewport height in CSS pixels. [default: 720]
  -a, --allow <values>     [repeatable] Another host pattern the page may reach (repeatable). [default: null]
  --headed                 Show the browser window.

result.stdout:
Usage: cdp snapshot <url> [options]

   Open one page and print its accessibility tree. Only the page's host is reachable unless allowed.

Arguments:
  <url>  A URL, or a local HTML file.

Global options:
  -h, --help               Show help.

Options:
  -c, --compact            Drop empty structure and list markers.
  -i, --interactive        Only controls, headings and named landmarks.
  -d, --depth <value>      Levels below the top to print. [default: default]
  -s, --selector <string>  Only the tree of the first element this CSS selector matches. [default: null]
  -a, --allow <values>     [repeatable] Another host pattern the page may reach (repeatable). [default: null]
  --headed                 Show the browser window.
  --max-output <int>       Characters before the tree is cut (0 for no limit). [default: 20000]
